author: Stuarts
body:
Age : 18 | Name: Stuart Rochard
Timezone : Paris , France.

Teamspeak : DrengiaStuarts
Discord : Stuart [Drengia]#4374
Recording Software : OBS or XSplit Broadcaster

             Self Reflection/Evaluation :

 Hello , Formerly known as SRochard , I have been entrusted the Admin position on several reputed servers.
 Theses servers known as ImpactMC and InitiaNova are well known pixelmon servers and I became staff during their peak
 of players.
 I started playing ImpactMC back when Pixelmon was in it's 1.6 version and I obtained the Admin position about 2 and a half years
 later , after the server's success and huge community , the owner decided to branch out the server into different categories by creating a
 lobby from wich the players could choose between Factions/Prison/Avatar/Pixelmon.
 I then became the Server Manager for Factions and Prison , Prison was more successfull than Factions but we realised a few months
 later that Players prefered Pixelmon and weren't too keen on sticking to PvP servers.
 A few Owners from ImpactMC conflicted and decided that they could no longer work together, so one of them created InitiaNova (wich is     still up and running)  , and I was offered the Builder position soon after and I went on to build them the best Pokemon Gyms. Later on the Owner realised I was trustworthy and offered a promotion to become staff, at this point I had to pick between servers and decided to stick to InitiaNova wich wasn't very popular at the time. Some time after I left ImpactMC , the said server started to slowly lose players as they couldn't find good builders to re-new their spawn and gyms.
Nowadays I retired as Admin soon to be head admin to work on my studies 2 years ago, but InitiaNova still grants me Admin permissions and knows that if they ever need help with staff or building, that I'll be there to help.

My biggest weakness when it comes to moderating would be persisting to reason with unreasonable players. As I used to be Staff on a modded server, hacks weren't present and punishing a player would need a lot of evidence or misbehaviour, and having to explain rules to someone who can't admitt their wrong is very troubling, especially when other players are waiting for help. But mind you, I can multitask. It won't affect my moderating as I can now tell the difference between a mistake and an intentional fraud.

I believe there is a difference between a leader and a dictator , a leader is someone who is behind their team and is willing to guide even thoses who fall behind. I don't think a leader is someone who gives just orders , but I do believe that for there to be a leader, there must be a team and for that respect should be mutual and be shared between everyone.
I was head of a Building team back when I was in my Pixelmon days, and since everyone respected eachother, even when we disagreed on some points we still managed to find comon ground. So I know I can be a leader, but I can also be a listener.

I like to believe that I've been Staff long enough that I had to deal with any situation twice or more and that I know enough to handle new ones. I also am quite Silly but I still am serious when I have to , I always know when I have to be serious and handle matters with maturity.

I believe you need to know a community long enough to know the mindset of certain players, or enough to make a general assumption , just enough not to be manipulated by anyone pretending to be your friend. I am quite certain I have the skills to handle being in the Avicus community, without wanting to sound arrogant of course.

The three main traits would be :
- Knowing when to be Serious
- Professional
- Loyal

             General Situations :

° I would have a higher ranking staff member notice their punishment pattern, and if it is still out of hand, I would confront the Staff
 member in a civil manner.

° If it is allowed , then I will not partake in the conversation, as long as they are not harassing anyone all I can say is for them to take their
 racial disrespectful conversation elsewhere. And if it really is outrageous I'll try to reason with them, but I am not one to gossip or talk behind someone's back nor spread what has been said in the nightclub.

° What I would do is simply tell them not to post staff-only threads for the public to see. They might see their mistake and not act upon it again.

° If the senior Staff Harass users and they come to me to complain, I'll just mention thoses who are bothered by it or mention to the seniors that it is bothering all the players. Since they are Seniors, they'll know to quiet down their game if they see the trouble caused.

                          Other :

I want to be a moderator because I know that by being committed to the server, I'll be closer to the community, forge new friendships
, contribute to the server and help thoses in need. I know being staff is no fun and games as I have been through the cycle several times,
but deciding to apply for staff means a lot to me and proves I am ready to commit to a serious relationship with Avicus.

Avicus means so so much to me , when I joined the server for the first time back when it was called MCzone, I played so many nights in a row just because it was fun. One day I thought hacking was Okay since I saw so many do it, and got banned. I regretted getting banned so much for what I did, I didn't even dare to apeal. One year after I took my courage to apeal my banishment , and did get unbanned, I was so happy I swore to never hack again. Even if my profile says only "3days spent on Avicus" , I feel like it's been so much more with all theses hours of fun scattered across years of gaming. If Avicus were to disapear I would be devastated.

I chose to apply to Avicus, as I am emotionnaly attached to this server and that I think I have the required experience and skill to make it into the Staff team. I have been addicted to many servers in the past but never applied since I knew the community was toxic, but Avicus' community is so rich and amazing. Honestly this server Motivates me beyond possibility.

Might I add that I have a great History with Minecraft and that I stopped playing the game for around a year, but got active again just for Avicus , so even if my application gets rejected I will always be loyal to the server.

Hacking: as I mentioned I used to hack, and previously from the ban I used to hack a lot on MineTime. But I assure you I don't hack anymore, but my point is I know how hacks work and can tell who is legit and who is not.

I hope you will be willing to lend me your trust and I hope I have the skills and experience you are looking for,
If you want to know anymore about me , feel free to contact me through discord.

Thank you for taking your time in reading this and have a wonderfull day !


- Stuart Rochard
